name: Hessian Matrix Analysis
description: Computes second-order Hessian matrix to detect curvature anomalies in pixel intensity surface (Bay et al., 2008 SURF).
mechanism: Abandoning shallow chromatic perception, Hessian violently tunnels through space into the 2nd-Order Derivative bedrock (capturing photonic velocity acceleration). Take two pixels spliced from a jacket onto a brick wall: The amateur eye perceives seamless integration. But when computing the photonic 'Acceleration' with Hessian, a catastrophic anomaly detonates! It violently lurches like a racecar brutally careening off a cliff because the color-acceleration was idiotically stretched and warped by an amateur editor. Hessian skins the entire canvas, exposing a raw vascular web. Wherever this web is grotesquely swollen, mangled, or severed right at a suspected border—the guillotine drops.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
